correctness.rationale: The Fourier autocorrelation of each unimodular row h_j forces a unique nonzero ordered Fourier difference to have zero product; for 2 or 3 frequencies a singleton difference always exists at odd prime p>=5. Thus each row has 1 or >=4 frequencies. When a row is a character, the translation ratios r_j form a subgroup of Z_p, giving either exactly one or all p character rows and totals >=4p-3 or p. The all-character cocycle telescopes to matching quadratic phases. Full support and nonzero modulus are essential; no claim that the second lower bound is achieved. Independently enumerated 1176 three-frequency difference supports and 8909 chirp configurations.
